subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up: token volumes and target $/1M
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps — model mix, volumes, target $/1M

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary of what I heard on the call:
- Primary use: customer support LLM for ticket triage + smart suggestions (chat).
- Secondary uses: semantic search/knowledge retrieval (embeddings) and an offline reranker for top-k results (rerank).
- Current traffic estimate: ~1M interactions/month initially, hoping to scale to 5-10M within 12 months.
- Key constraint: predictable unit economics and a target cost around $X per 1M tokens (you asked for refinements here).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Alex to confirm expected average prompt+response token counts for each model type (chat, embeddings, rerank).
2) Marissa to send a model-mix pricing + volume sensitivity spreadsheet and a preliminary target $/1M analysis (attached).
3) If the numbers look good, schedule a 30-min follow-up with your engineering lead to discuss integration and SSO.

I attached a quick model-mix workbook with three scenarios (conservative / expected / aggressive) and per-model token assumptions. Below is the short summary we discussed for expected case: 
- Chat (conversational): 70% of calls, avg 500 tokens per interaction (prompt+response)
- Embeddings (vectorization for search): 20% of calls, avg 1,000 tokens per embedding request
- Rerank (batch reranking of top-50): 10% of calls, avg 250 tokens per item (50 items per batch = 12,500 tokens per rerank call — we model at 50 rerank calls per 1,000 interactions)

Target unit economics (you asked for per-1M guidance):
- We showed a ballpark today of $Y-$Z per 1M tokens depending on model family and quantization/profile; I'll convert that into scenario pricing in the attached.

Thanks — can you confirm the token assumptions (or paste your actual telemetry if easier)?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0186

Attachment: Brightlayer_model_mix_estimate.xlsx

From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — model mix, volumes, target $/1M

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the detailed recap and the workbook. A few clarifications / confirmatory numbers from our side:
- We expect ~1.2M interactions/month to start (customer-facing agents + triage), ramping to ~6M in 9-12 months if the pilot goes well.
- Token breakdown (rough telemetry):
  * Chat: Avg prompt 120 tokens, avg model response 380 tokens => ~500 tokens interaction (matches your assumption).
  * Embeddings: Most calls are text-to-vector for 1-2 paragraphs => 900-1100 tokens; 1,000 tokens is fine as an average.
  * Rerank: We run a nightly job for refreshed search results — ~50 rerank jobs / 1,000 interactions seems high for our case. More realistic: 5 rerank jobs / 1,000 interactions initially. We'll err on the conservative side.

Budget / target economics:
- Leadership has given us an internal target of ~$350-$450 per 1M tokens for the initial contract year (this includes inference + minimal observability retention). We understand higher-performance models will be above this and quantized/embedded variants will be below.

Can you map the scenario workbook to that target and show: (a) per-model $/1M for chat/embeddings/rerank under expected volumes, (b) blended $/1M for the overall mix, and (c) a 12-month ramp sensitivity?

Also, please attach any example SOW language around data retention and audit logs - security will ask.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product - Brightlayer
alex.jensen@brightlayer.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — model mix, volumes, target $/1M

Alex —

Great, thanks for the confirm. I've updated the attached workbook (v2) with the tweaks you mentioned (rerank frequency lowered, explicit 9-12 month ramp). Summary below (expected case):

Per-model assumptions (expected case):
- Chat: 70% of interactions, 500 tokens/interaction => 3.5M tokens/month at 5M interactions (example ramp case).
- Embeddings: 20% of interactions, 1,000 tokens/request => 1.0M tokens/month at 5M interactions.
- Rerank: 10% of interactions, but with your corrected frequency that maps to 0.5M tokens/month at 5M interactions (we model conservative rerank jobs).

Pricing scenarios (per-1M token):
- Chat (standard quantized chat model): $375 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (mid-tier vector model): $220 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (smaller rerank model, batch optimized): $150 / 1M tokens

Blended expected rate (at the 70/20/10 split above) => ~ $325 / 1M tokens.

12-month ramp sensitivity (blended):
- Conservative (1.2M => 2.5M interactions): $360 / 1M blended
- Expected (1.2M => 5.0M interactions): $325 / 1M blended
- Aggressive (1.2M => 10M interactions): $295 / 1M blended

Notes and levers:
- We can lower chat unit cost by recommending a quantized chat variant for non-customer-facing prompts and by enabling prefix/KV caching for repeated flows.
- Embeddings volume pricing can be optimized via batching and a caching layer for repeated vectors - we show potential 15-25% savings in the workbook if implemented.
- Rerank is highly batch-sensitive; moving to nightly batch reranks reduces per-1M effective cost.

Attached: Brightlayer_model_mix_estimate_v2.xlsx and Redwood_pricing_preview.pdf (sample SOW language + retention commitments).

Next steps:
1) If that blended range ($295- $360) aligns with your expectations, I'll put together a pilot commercial term (3-month pilot, committed baseline + overage) and share a redlineable SOW.
2) Dev - can you confirm whether the proposed SSO/KMS integrations and audit-log retention in the sample SOW are feasible for a pilot?

Thanks - I'll stand by for your go/no-go and we can schedule the engineering sync.

Best,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — model mix, volumes, target $/1M

Thanks Marissa / Alex —

Quick technical confirmation on the asks in the sample SOW / pricing preview:
- SSO: We support SAML-based SSO and can onboard Brightlayer in the pilot window; we'll need an IdP test tenant and a point of contact.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/HSM for Private deployments; for the hosted pilot we offer envelope encryption with BYOK & HSM-backed options on request.
- Audit logs & retention: We can offer event-level logs with 90-day retention in the pilot, with enterprise retention tiers available as an add-on.
- Integration note: To estimate tokens precisely we'll need a 2-week trace of representative traffic or sample payloads (pseudonymized). If Brightlayer can share sanitized telemetry, we can give a tighter blended $/1M and CPU/GPU footprint estimate.

I'll be available for the engineering sync - propose next Wed 9-11am PT?

Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
